# DECCAN — Card List

<!-- GENERATED FROM sim/cards.mjs BY `npm run cards`. DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE. -->

**8 factions × 7 units = 56 cards, plus 20 Power Brokers — 76 in the box.**

## The ring

> ELEPHANT → RIFLEMAN → CANNON → HORSEMAN → WARRIOR → back to ELEPHANT

Each arm cancels the **next two** along the ring, and is cancelled by the two behind it.

| Arm | Force unit | Power Broker | cancels | cancelled by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **ELEPHANT** | Elephant **9** | Siege Elephant **10** | RIFLEMAN, CANNON | HORSEMAN, WARRIOR |
| **CANNON** | Cannon **7** | Sultan Rockets **8** | HORSEMAN, WARRIOR | ELEPHANT, RIFLEMAN |
| **HORSEMAN** | Horseman **5** | Spy **6** | WARRIOR, ELEPHANT | RIFLEMAN, CANNON |
| **RIFLEMAN** | Rifleman **3** | Sepoy **4** | CANNON, HORSEMAN | ELEPHANT, WARRIOR |
| **WARRIOR** | Warrior **1** | Subhedar **2** | ELEPHANT, RIFLEMAN | CANNON, HORSEMAN |

Force strengths are **odd** and Power Broker strengths **even**, so a Force unit and a broker
can never tie, and every broker is exactly one better than its own arm's Force unit.

## The eight rulers

Each holds seven units. A **specialist** takes three of one arm; a **pair** takes two of its
arm and two of the next arm round the ring. Everyone holds at least one of every arm, so
every ruler can answer every arm.

| Ruler | | Force | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| **The Sultan** | three elephant | E9 E9 E9 C7 H5 R3 W1 | 43 |
| **The Badshah** | three cannon | E9 C7 C7 C7 H5 R3 W1 | 39 |
| **The Peshwa** | three horseman | E9 C7 H5 H5 H5 R3 W1 | 35 |
| **The Governor** | three rifleman | E9 C7 H5 R3 R3 R3 W1 | 31 |
| **The Rana** | three warrior | E9 C7 H5 R3 W1 W1 W1 | 27 |
| **The Nizam** | two cannon + two horseman | E9 C7 C7 H5 H5 R3 W1 | 37 |
| **The Nawab** | two rifleman + two cannon | E9 C7 C7 H5 R3 R3 W1 | 35 |
| **The Maharaja** | two horseman + two warrior | E9 C7 H5 H5 R3 W1 W1 | 31 |

*The Sultan — war elephants of the Deccan courts.*  
*The Badshah — the imperial gun train.*  
*The Peshwa — Ganimi Kava, and horse that never stands.*  
*The Governor — matchlocks drilled off the ships.*  
*The Rana — the last stand on foot.*  
*The Nizam — guns, and the horse that screens them.*  
*The Nawab — a fortress of musket and cannon.*  
*The Maharaja — horse and foot, and nothing bought.*  

## The supply

4 of each, 20 cards. Recruited by **losing** — one per defeated player,
whatever they committed.

| Power Broker | | Arm | Ability |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- |
| **Siege Elephant** | 10 | ELEPHANT | Deploy FACE UP. On deployment, REVEAL any one enemy unit. |
| **Sultan Rockets** | 8 | CANNON | If your army LOSES, burn every recovering unit of the winning army. |
| **Spy** | 6 | HORSEMAN | SWAP with the strongest unit of the opposing army. The exchange is PERMANENT — each card joins the other player's force for the rest of the game. |
| **Sepoy** | 4 | RIFLEMAN | While ALONE in your army, fight at double strength. |
| **Subhedar** | 2 | WARRIOR | REMOVE the weakest unit of the opposing army. |
